init.title: Zone Control Methods
init.description:
Choose the control method for each zone:

{zone_list}

Use IR if a uControl pack is assigned to that output port. Use CEC for HDMI-CEC control. Use None to disable IR and CEC button entities.

After saving, reload the integration to apply changes.

zone_commands.title: Select Commands - {zone_label}
zone_commands.description: Choose which {method} commands to expose as buttons for {zone_label}. Deselect commands you don't need. {command_count} commands available.
